C-01.hypothesis: The census's own A/B/C press-kit priority and the specimen's Tier 1/2/3 gate test classify the same 133 records differently, and the disagreement is concentrated in one identifiable block rather than spread evenly.
C-01.statistic: Cohen's kappa and Spearman between the two rankings, permutation null (10k shuffles of tier labels), plus a deterministic decomposition by block and a three-way sensitivity analysis on the contested block.
C-01.falsifier: Measure each of the 60 compilation labels' acceptance policy. If they are uniformly juried (or uniformly open), the hinge disappears and the two rankings converge without an assumption; kappa should then be stable across all three coding schemes.
C-01.verdict_note: the hinge: 60 of 133 records decide whether the two rankings agree at chance (kappa 0.002) or moderately (kappa 0.507)

result.spearman_note: sign flipped so that +1 = the two classifiers agree (A<->Tier 1)

C-02.hypothesis: Chain-of-custody compliance falls as an artifact gets closer to raw data: the INDEX stratum out-scores the EVIDENCE stratum on the handbook's own seven elements.
C-02.statistic: Seven-element battery scored over 117 artifacts; permutation test on the INDEX-minus-EVIDENCE mean; Spearman between citation frequency and custody score; negative control NC-3 (an arbitrary seven-feature battery).
C-02.falsifier: If NC-3's arbitrary battery fails to separate the same two strata, the handbook battery is measuring governance and the finding stands.
C-02.verdict_note: the arbitrary battery NC-3 separates the same two strata more strongly (p=0.0015) than the handbook battery (p=0.049); citation-vs-custody rho=0.02

C-03.hypothesis: The excavation report's census numbers are exact where it repeats a number the vault already asserted, and wrong where it had to count for itself.
C-03.statistic: Fifteen claimed quantities re-measured from the file tree, the CSV and the XLSX; contingency of exactness against 'asserted elsewhere' (context-matched search).
C-03.falsifier: Any self-derived count that measures exact, or any cited count that measures wrong.
C-03.verdict_note: 8 of 15 counts wrong, but wrongness is unrelated to citation (86% vs 88%); the hypothesis dies and a defect list survives

C-04.hypothesis: Both recording systems batch their omissions: unresolvable identifiers are over-dispersed across units in the same way in the catalog and in the link graph.
C-04.statistic: Index of dispersion, top-decile gap share and all-gap-unit count in each system, each against 10k permutations that preserve unit sizes and gap totals.
C-04.falsifier: Either system's gaps matching its own null, or the two systems' dispersion indices falling inside each other's null range.
C-04.verdict_note: opposite geometries: catalog gaps batched (p=0.003), link gaps anti-batched at unit level (p=1.0)

C-05.hypothesis: Prediction B's three conditions can each be evaluated from committed artifacts, and the falsifier 'track #201' points at a real slot in the catalog's own numbering.
C-05.statistic: Deterministic evaluation of the three conditions at day 28 of the 30-day window; row-level inspection of the CATALOG sheet's numbering; dateline-based accretion count for the window.
C-05.falsifier: A committed artifact after 2026-09-02 that fills a ledger line, ships a numbered track, or publishes a first-person rate.
C-05.verdict_note: the falsifier's referent is broken: the last real track is #197, so '#201' is four releases away, not one

condition_b.note: the numbering the prediction cites ends in summary rows, not tracks

C-06.hypothesis: The corpus's moral-foundation vocabulary enacts the subject's moral-foundation scores: Liberty (30/30) should be denser in the prose than Care (8/30).
C-06.statistic: Density per 10k content words for six transparent lexicons; Spearman against the six scores; permutation over all 720 lexicon-to-score assignments.
C-06.falsifier: rho >= 0.83 at p < 0.05 under the 720-assignment permutation, or the Liberty:Care density ratio exceeding the 3.75 score ratio.
C-06.verdict_note: rho=0.54, p=0.13; the pre-registered contrast inverts (Care densest)

C-07.hypothesis: The mythography's distinctive vocabulary and proper names appear in track titles above the frequency-matched chance rate.
C-07.statistic: Titles containing >=1 of 100 distinctive ☾ terms, against 2k frequency-matched random lexicons; twelve proper names checked literally; self-rank validity gate.
C-07.falsifier: Any ☾ term or name appearing in a track title; the gate failing (which would void the beam).
C-07.verdict_note: 0 of 203 objects, 0 of 12 proper names, p=1.0 against a frequency-matched null

sources: Dr. Caligo Vespertine in the Negative Observatory.md

C-07b.hypothesis: F-10's claim that the catalog and the vault are 'the same document in two file formats' holds at the level of vocabulary, not merely register: each stratum's distinctive lexicon should transfer into track titles above chance.
C-07b.statistic: One frequency-matched transfer test per stratum (800 permutations each) plus a contamination re-run with catalog-quoting documents removed from the source set.
C-07b.falsifier: Any stratum whose lexicon transfers at p < 0.05 after catalog-quoting sources are removed.
C-07b.verdict_note: zero genuine transfer from any of the eight strata; the single apparent hit is reproduced entirely by documents that already quote the catalog

C-08.hypothesis: The census is written in the mechanism vocabulary the specimen cabinet defines.
C-08.statistic: Occurrences per 10k words of the 288 terms in every pool artifact; the census's rank of 112 gives p; self-rank gate on the glossary itself.
C-08.falsifier: The census ranking in the top decile of the vault for mechanism-vocabulary density.
C-08.verdict_note: rank 61 of 112, p=0.54; 4 of 288 terms present

C-09.statistic: Field-by-field schema fit: the console's five fields (three required) against the ledger line format, counted over all thirteen lines.
C-09.falsifier: One committed receipt artifact whose fields are populated from a ledger line, or a console revision that drops the evidence requirement.
C-09.verdict_note: 0 of 13 lines filable: the console requires the one field the ledger format never emits
